gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Gugi draws bold, uniform-stroke letters with open-cut terminals, a display face that makes itself known the moment it lands. Noto Sans Tai Tham echoes that with lowercase crowding the capital line.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Chunky and unmistakable, Gugi holds every stroke to one thickness, while Noto Sans Tai Viet counters with short ascenders. Barely any stroke contrast unites them, heading and body alike.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-takri: Gugi looks like laser-cut sheet, every stroke one width and every terminal sliced open. And Noto Sans Takri leaves its small round letters generously unclosed, which keeps the pair feeling open throughout.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide and keeps its ascender stems short. And paragraph after paragraph feels gentle and inviting, while Gugi holds a constant bold stroke up top.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Open-cut terminals and curves that never pinch give Gugi its bold, distinctive face. Noto Sans Telugu, sans-serif through and through, keeps its counters connected to the outside, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-thai: Crossbars matching the stems make Gugi bold and blunt. That punch is best kept for the heading, while Noto Sans Thai swells like inflated glass beads and leaves its rounds open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: A tube-like stroke of constant width gives Gugi its bold, distinctive look, with terminals cut open. And Noto Sans Thai Looped matches that weight with bold-looking lowercase and spacious gaps at its curve ends.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Marker-bold and unmistakable, Gugi holds a steady line with its terminals cut open. And Noto Sans Tifinagh, sans-serif and rounded, fills its lines with inflated bowls that read comfortably.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap and lets the x-height dominate. Noto Sans Tirhuta takes the reading, while Gugi, whose horizontals match its verticals, does the shouting.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Noto Sans Vithkuqi opens the throats of a, c, s and e, and barely steps down from capitals to lowercase. Page after page stays easy going, a quiet foil for Gugi.
